candidate.definition_en: The action of persuading someone to do or believe something.
candidate.explanation_ar: فن إقناع الناس برأيك أو جعلهم يقومون بشيء معين بالكلام المقنع والمنطق.

senses.definition_en: The action or process of convincing someone to do or believe something.
senses.definition_ar: عملية أو مهارة إقناع شخص بفعل شيء أو اعتناق رأي معين.
examples: It took a lot of persuasion to get him to agree.
The power of persuasion is a key skill in sales.
She used persuasion to get what she wanted.
It took a lot of persuasion to get him to agree.
The power of persuasion is a key skill in sales.
She used persuasion to get what she wanted.
candidate.mnemonic: الفعل 'Persuade'.. افتكر 'Pursue' يطارد.. بتفضل ورا الشخص لحد ما تقنعه.
